# Good Pick Coffee Cart

> Good Pick is a mobile coffee cart and coffee catering company based in Los Angeles, CA. It is not a coffee shop and has no storefront. Event baristas bring a staffed espresso and matcha bar to corporate events, brand activations, film sets, sports events, holiday parties, and private parties.

Business facts:
- Name: Good Pick Coffee Cart (Good Pick Coffee Cart LLC)
- Type: Mobile coffee cart and coffee catering for events
- Phone: (310) 220-0582
- Email: info@goodpickcoffee.com
- Website: https://goodpickcoffee.com/
- Rating: 5.0 stars on Google Reviews
- Service area: Los Angeles, Malibu, San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and other parts of Southern California
- Booking: Request a quote at https://goodpickcoffee.com/contact

What Good Pick offers:
- Coffee cart catering with professional event baristas and an espresso and specialty drink menu
- Matcha cart catering, as an add-on or standalone bar
- Custom branding: cart wraps, LED screens, branded cups, custom menus, and logo latte art
- Multiple-cart setups for large events
- Corporate invoicing and procurement-friendly paperwork

Common questions:
- Is Good Pick a coffee shop? No. It is a mobile coffee cart that travels to the event.
- How far ahead should I book? 2-3 weeks for standard events and 4-6 weeks for custom branding.
- Can Good Pick handle large events? Yes, with multiple carts and coordinated barista teams.
